ownmods.mousewheel.title: Mouse wheel
ownmods.mousewheel.description: Moves items between inventory and storage with the mouse wheel.
ownmods.mousewheel.enabled.tip: Scroll up: always toward storage. Scroll down: always toward the player inventory.
ownmods.mousewheel.invert.tip: Swaps the destinations: up to inventory, down to storage.
